subject: Capacity settlement & one-time true-up for Q3 usage
messages:
From: Claire Martin <claire.martin@finlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Reconciliation: Q3 retroactive capacity usage

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the help during our renewal conversations. As we pulled our final billing for Q3, we discovered a chunk of burst capacity that wasn’t accounted for in the committed capacity on our contract between 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-30.

Summary:
- Platform account: Finlytics Inc. (account ID: FL-1192)
- Uncommitted burst consumption: ~1,260,000 generation tokens across 3 major pipelines
- Expected true-up: vendor-provided SKU rate (as discussed during PO)

Could you confirm next steps to reconcile and produce a one-time settlement invoice? Billing would prefer a breakdown by SKU and dates so we can attach it to our internal audit. I’ve attached our usage export for Q3.

Thanks,
Claire Martin
Head of Data Products
Finlytics Inc.
[attachment: usage_report_Q3.csv]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Martin <claire.martin@finlytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reconciliation: Q3 retroactive capacity usage

Hi Claire — appreciate the heads up and the CSV. I pulled this into our billing workstream and sketched a reconciliation plan below.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Redwood confirms SKU mapping and per-token rates (we’ll do this by 11/20).
2) Redwood provides an itemized settlement draft (dates, SKU, units, per-unit rate) for your review — target 11/23.
3) You confirm PO/approval and payment terms (net30 preferred by us; if you need net45 we can accommodate).
4) Redwood issues final invoice and attaches audit logs and a CSV matching your export.

One ask: can you confirm the three pipelines by name (prod-summarize, prod-chat, ingestion-embed) so Neha can map consumption to the right SKUs? I’ve CC’d Neha and Laura from Billing to own the calculations and invoice issuance.

I’ll start the SKU reconciliation today and loop back with estimated one-time charge.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Reconciliation: Q3 retroactive capacity usage

Ben / Laura — I mapped the usage CSV Claire sent to our internal SKU table. Notes:
- prod-summarize -> sku-gen-medium (0.008 USD / 1k tokens)
- prod-chat -> sku-gen-large (0.012 USD / 1k tokens)
- ingestion-embed -> sku-embed-2x (0.0025 USD / 1k tokens)

Raw numbers (rounded):
- summarize: 420,000 tokens -> $3,360
- chat: 610,000 tokens -> $7,320
- embed: 230,000 tokens -> $575

Subtotal one-time charge: $11,255
Tax and small rounding buffer (~5%): $565
Estimated total: $11,820

I recommend we present: itemized draft (line items above), attach raw invoice CSV, and include a brief two-line note on why burst consumption wasn’t captured (timing/contract alignment). Laura — can you confirm if we should apply any goodwill credit? From a renewal perspective I’d advocate a modest credit (5% of subtotal) to keep the expansion momentum.

Attachments: internal mapping spreadsheet stub (not shared externally yet).

-Neha
Senior Billing Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Martin <claire.martin@finlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T11:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reconciliation: Q3 retroactive capacity usage

Thanks Ben / Neha — that breakdown looks correct to our team.

We confirm the pipeline names and accept the mapping. A few operational items:
- We request a formal invoice that lists SKU-level quantities and the dates covered (7/01/26 - 9/30/26).
- We will issue PO FIN-2026-11-334 once we receive the draft invoice and can route through our procurement queue.
- Payment term: Net30. Please include the full audit CSV and a short note about the reconciliation method.

I uploaded our final internal copy of the usage export and a purchase request form to our shared folder.

[attachment: usage_report_Q3.csv]
[attachment: purchase_request_FIN-2026-11-334.pdf]

Claire Martin
Head of Data Products
Finlytics Inc.
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Claire Martin <claire.martin@finlytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Reconciliation: Q3 retroactive capacity usage — settlement & invoice

Claire — thanks for the quick turnaround. Final update and next steps: 

1) Final settlement amount: $11,229 (subtotal after a 5% courtesy credit on the $11,255 subtotal; tax/rounding consolidated).
2) I’ve attached the finalized invoice (final_settlement_invoice_334.pdf) and the Redwood audit CSV that aligns with your export.
3) Payment terms: Net30 as requested. PO FIN-2026-11-334 referenced on the invoice.
4) For signature: we can route the invoice via DocuSign if you prefer — here’s the link: https://redwood.docusign.com/signed/fin-8274 (will expire in 7 days).

Preview of the invoice line items (excerpt):
- sku-gen-large (prod-chat) — 610,000 tokens — $7,320
- sku-gen-medium (prod-summarize) — 420,000 tokens — $3,360
- sku-embed-2x (ingestion-embed) — 230,000 tokens — $575
- Courtesy credit (5% of subtotal) — -$565

Attachments: final_settlement_invoice_334.pdf, usage_report_Q3_aligned.csv

Once you sign, we’ll mark the account as reconciled and apply the expansion seat addendum to your renewal (per the renewed terms). Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
